name: Chile
description: Chile from the Chinchorro mummies and the Mapuche to Spanish rule, independence, saltpetre, Allende, Pinochet and democracy.

checkpoints.name: First peoples
checkpoints.note: Fishing people of the north made the world's oldest mummies. The Incas reached the centre, but the Mapuche of the south held them off.

checkpoints.name: Colony and independence
checkpoints.note: Valdivia founded Santiago in 1541. The Mapuche resisted for centuries, and O'Higgins and San Martín won independence in 1818.

checkpoints.name: Nitrates and reform
checkpoints.note: Victory in the War of the Pacific brought nitrate riches. Mistral and Neruda wrote, and Allende was elected in 1970.

checkpoints.name: Dictatorship and democracy
checkpoints.note: The coup of 1973 began Pinochet's long rule. Chileans voted him out in 1988, and democracy returned in 1990.
